questions.question: In a balanced three-phase circuit, the phase voltages are separated by:
questions.explanation:
Three-phase systems have three sine waves equally spaced.
Each phase is 120 electrical degrees apart.
This gives smoother power than single-phase.

questions.question: What does SCR stand for?
questions.explanation:
SCR means silicon-controlled rectifier.
It is a controlled semiconductor device.
It can switch power when triggered.

questions.category: C4 - Use measuring and testing equipment
questions.question: When checking insulation resistance of a motor winding, which instrument is commonly used?
questions.explanation:
A megohmmeter applies test voltage to measure insulation resistance.
It helps detect insulation breakdown.
The circuit must be isolated before testing.

questions.category: D1 - Interpret plans, drawings and specifications
questions.question: A drawing shows “MCC-1.” What does MCC usually mean?
questions.explanation:
MCC means motor control centre.
It contains starters, feeders, and control equipment.
It is common in industrial installations.

questions.category: H2 - Install three-phase consumer/supply services and metering equipment
questions.question: A 347/600 V three-phase service provides 347 V from:
questions.explanation:
A 347/600 V wye system has 600 V line-to-line.
Line-to-neutral voltage is 347 V.
This is common in commercial buildings.
